rows.name: CCBHC Planning, Development & Implementation (SM-26-014)
rows.program: Certified Community Behavioral Health Clinics PDI
rows.heart: 94 CCBHCs are writing applications right now — MORE goes in as their evidence-based line item and strengthens their scoring. Nonprofits and local government only, so this is a pure partner play: the insert kit goes out before the 17th.
rows.eligibility: Community-based behavioral health nonprofits; local-government behavioral health authorities; IHS / tribal / Urban Indian organizations. For-profits cannot apply.
rows.portal: Grants.gov (partners apply; MORE rides as line item)
rows.scoring_map: MORE evidence (59% dropout reduction, ~3x CBT) strengthens the evidence-based-practices section of a CCBHC application
rows.notes: Insert-kit campaign to CCBHC applicants + state associations before 8/17 — campaign go/no-go is open decision #5.

rows.name: NIH/NIDA SBIR Phase I (PA-27-100)
rows.heart: The one big pot built for for-profits — R&D money for the MORE app and training platform. Eric wants the ~$2M path; Phase I is the door, first standard due date Sep 8.
rows.eligibility: US for-profit small business, ≤500 employees, majority US-owned — More Therapy qualifies as-is.
rows.accounts_needed: SAM/UEI + eRA Commons — register now, takes weeks
rows.scoring_map: NIDA caps: Phase I $400K / Phase II $3M. Cycle recurs Jan 5 / Apr 5; parent open through 2027-04-05.
rows.notes: Dr. Garland owns. Phase I outline this week.

rows.name: Texas OAFC — Fall 2026 CORE grants
rows.heart: Settlement money with provider-friendly eligibility, opening this fall. Watch page and GovDelivery list are live; position before it posts.
rows.eligibility: Provider-friendly; applications via the Texas Opioid Grant Management System.
rows.accounts_needed: TX OGMS account; TX SmartBuy/CMBL ($70/yr) for vendor path
rows.notes: Join Comptroller GovDelivery list (L0 pass); pre-draft the TX provider pitch.

rows.name: HRSA RCORP — FY27 cycle
rows.heart: For-profits are explicitly eligible — rare for federal treatment money. FY26 closed in June; FY27 expected around May. Prep now, apply day one.
rows.eligibility: For-profits explicitly eligible; rural service area required.
rows.scoring_map: FY26 shape: Planning $100K × 40 · Impact $60M ~80 awards $750K min
rows.notes: Draft the rural partner map now (MAT/MOUD sites in rural counties) so the FY27 application starts day one.

rows.name: OneOhio Recovery Foundation — Cycle 3
rows.heart: For-profits eligible; Cycle 2 was $45.7M. Roughly annual — verify More Therapy's 2-year Ohio registration now so eligibility is ready when it opens.
rows.eligibility: For-profits eligible IF 2+ consecutive years registered with the Ohio Secretary of State — verify More Therapy's status (open decision #6) or line up an Ohio partner.
rows.scoring_map: Cycle 2 pattern: RFP Dec 10 → inquiry Jan 14–Feb 11 → awards mid-year

rows.name: Allegheny County OSF — annual RFP
rows.heart: Annual county settlement RFP — opens around November, due January. Calendar it; the county pattern of 3–6-week windows is the volume play nationwide.
rows.eligibility: County RFP via Bonfire; historically opens ~third week of November, due January.
rows.notes: Template for the national county sweep — the weekly scan hunts for RFPs shaped like this in every settlement-funded county.

rows.name: Virginia OAA — FY28 city & county cycle
rows.heart: Only Virginia localities can apply — MORE rides in as their named training vendor. Annual cycle; pitch localities while they draft.
rows.eligibility: VA cities/counties apply on an annual cycle (roughly Aug–Mar windows); vendors are named inside locality applications.
rows.portal: VA OAA portal (localities); eVA vendor registration (free) for MORE
rows.notes: Identify 3–5 VA localities with unspent abatement funds and offer the insert kit while they draft.
